chapter.heading: A Calm Resolve to Wait for the Salvation of GodTo the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Truly my
soul silently waits for God;From Him comes my salvation. [Ps. 102:13; Is.] [Is. 41:8, 9; Zech. 1:17; 2:12 c Is. 60:4,]

He only
is my rock and my salvation;He is my defense;I shall not be greatly moved. [Is. 60:14] [Is. 49:22; 60:9;]

How long
will you attack a man?You shall be slain, all of you,Like a leaning wall and a tottering fence.

They only
consult to cast him down from his high position;They delight in lies;They bless with their mouth,But they curse inwardly.Selah [Is. 13:19; Hab. 2:6 g Rev. 18:16]

My soul,
wait silently for God alone,For my expectation is from Him. [Ps. 125:3]

He only
is my rock and my salvation;He is my defense;I shall not be moved.

In God
is my salvation and my glory;The rock of my strength,And my refuge, is in God.

Trust in
Him at all times, you people;Pour out your heart before Him;God is a refuge for us.Selah [Is. 55:12; Ezek.]

Surely men
of low degree are a vapor,Men of high degree are a lie;If they are weighed on the scales,They are altogether lighter than vapor. [Ezek. 32:21]

Do not
trust in oppression,Nor vainly hope in robbery;If riches increase,Do not set your heart on them.

God has
spoken once,Twice I have heard this:That power belongs to God.

Also to
You, O Lord, belongs mercy;For You render to each one according to his work. [Is. 34:4; Luke 10:18; [Rev. 12:7-9]]
